declarations.name: QtiChoiceInteraction
declarations.description: A single-response or multiple-response choice interaction.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. Space-separated; takes precedence over `orientation`.

attributes.name: max-choices
attributes.description: Maximum selectable choices. `1` is a single-response item; `0` means unlimited and makes it a multiple-response item.

attributes.name: min-choices
attributes.description: Minimum selectable choices for a valid response.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Deprecated by QTI in favour of the `qti-orientation-*` class vocabulary.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: shuffle
attributes.description: Requests choice shuffling. Applied by the transform pipeline (`qti-transformers`), not by this element.

declarations.name: QtiGapText
declarations.description: A draggable text token that fills a `qti-gap` inside `qti-gap-match-interaction`.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Pins this token in place when the interaction is shuffled.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded in the response pair when this token is placed into a gap.

attributes.name: match-max
attributes.description: How many gaps this token may fill; `0` means unlimited. Read from the DOM by the drag-drop mixin.

attributes.name: match-min
attributes.description: Minimum gaps this token must fill.

attributes.name: show-hide
attributes.description: Not implemented. How `template-identifier` controls visibility.

attributes.name: template-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a template variable controlling this token's visibility.

declarations.name: QtiGap
declarations.description:
A gap in the prose, and the first drop target to render its own chips.

The interaction owns placement and publishes it on `dragDropContext`; this element subscribes and
renders what it holds. Nothing appends into it. That inverts the old flow, where `handleDrop` did
`cloneNode` + `appendChild` and the response was recovered afterwards by reading the DOM back
out — which is why placement and the response could ever disagree at all.

The chips land in this shadow root rather than in the light DOM, so a theme reaches them as
`::part(drag)` — a bare `::part()` matches in any shadow root — instead of by tag. The gap's own
`:state(filled)` says whether it holds anything.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded as the gap side of the response pair.

attributes.name: match-max
attributes.description: How many tokens this gap can hold; `0` means unlimited. Read from the DOM by the drag-drop mixin.

attributes.name: match-min
attributes.description: Minimum tokens this gap must hold.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Not implemented. Whether this gap must be filled for the response to be valid.

attributes.name: show-hide
attributes.description: Not implemented. How `template-identifier` controls visibility.

attributes.name: template-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a template variable controlling this gap's visibility.

declarations.name: QtiHottext
declarations.description: A selectable span of text inside `qti-hottext-interaction`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded in the response when this span is selected.

attributes.name: show-hide
attributes.description: Not implemented. How `template-identifier` controls visibility.

attributes.name: template-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a template variable controlling this span's visibility.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded in the response when this option is selected.

attributes.name: show-hide

declarations.name: QtiSimpleAssociableChoice
declarations.description:
A choice in one of the two match sets of `qti-match-interaction`, or in
`qti-associate-interaction`.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Pins this choice in place when the enclosing interaction is shuffled.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded in the response pair when this choice participates in an association.

attributes.name: match-max
attributes.description: the maximum number of selections a candidate must make, the other options will be disabled when max options is checked

attributes.name: match-min
attributes.description: the minimal number of selections a candidate must make

attributes.name: show-hide
attributes.description: Not implemented. How `template-identifier` controls visibility.

attributes.name: template-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a template variable controlling this choice's visibility.

declarations.name: QtiSimpleChoice
declarations.description:
A choice, used by `qti-choice-interaction` and `qti-order-interaction`.

The `control` part is one box whose *role* is carried by state, not by its name: a radio
circle under `:state(radio)`, a checkbox square under `:state(checkbox)`, and a drag grip
when the choice is draggable. Style it as `qti-simple-choice::part(control)`.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Pins this choice in place when the enclosing interaction is shuffled.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Required. Value recorded in the response when this choice is selected, or its position when used for ordering.

attributes.name: show-hide
attributes.description: How `template-identifier` controls visibility.

attributes.name: template-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of a template variable controlling this choice's visibility.

attributes.name: base
attributes.description: Not implemented. Numeric base used when recording the value.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary controlling the rendered height. Outranks both `expected-lines` and `expected-length`.

attributes.name: data-patternmask-message
attributes.description: Custom validation message shown when `pattern-mask` fails. Part of the QTI shared interaction vocabulary.

attributes.name: expected-length
attributes.description: expected length is mapped to the property maxlength on the textarea

attributes.name: expected-lines
attributes.description: QTI's own hint at the response height. Outranked by `qti-height-lines-*`; see `#resolveRows`.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description:
How the response text is presented. Reflected so themes can key off
`:host([format='preformatted'])`.

`xhtml` is accepted and recorded but renders as `plain`: the field is a `<textarea>`, and
there is no rich-text editor behind it. Downgrading loudly beats either refusing valid QTI
or pretending to support formatting the candidate cannot actually produce.

attributes.name: max-strings
attributes.description: Not implemented. Maximum number of separate string responses. QTI defines these for a multi-string response — several bound variables, one field each. This element renders a single textarea bound to one variable, so there is nothing for the bounds to count: reading them as a word or paragraph limit would invent a rule QTI does not state. Implement alongside multi-string rendering, not before it.

attributes.name: min-strings
attributes.description: Not implemented. See `max-strings`.

attributes.name: pattern-mask
attributes.description: Regular expression the value must match to be valid.

attributes.name: placeholder-text
attributes.description: text appearing in the extended-text-interaction if it is empty

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: string-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a second, string-typed response variable that also receives the raw entry.

declarations.name: QtiHottextInteraction
declarations.description: Hottext interaction: candidates select highlighted words within a text block.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. `qti-unselected-hidden` leaves the selectable words visually indistinguishable from the surrounding prose until they are selected.

attributes.name: max-choices
attributes.description: Maximum selectable hottexts; `0` means unlimited.

attributes.name: min-choices
attributes.description: Minimum selectable hottexts for a valid response.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

declarations.name: QtiMatchInteraction
declarations.description: Match interaction: candidates pair items from two sets, either as drag-and-drop or as a tabular grid.

attributes.name: auto-size-dropzones
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Sizes every drop target to the widest chip so placement does not reflow the layout. The mixin default is `true`; this interaction is the one that overrides it to `false`, because a match target is a category card rather than a socket (see the field below and DROP-SIZING.md §1).

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. `qti-match-tabular` renders a checkbox/radio grid instead of drag-and-drop; the `qti-choices-*` values position the source set.

attributes.name: disable-animations
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Disables the FLIP move animation.

attributes.name: max-associations
attributes.description: Maximum pairings across the whole interaction; `0` means unlimited. QTI's own default is `1`; this element defaults to unlimited because a literal `1` breaks any multi-pair match item. See plans/interaction-attribute-spec-conformance.md.

attributes.name: min-associations
attributes.description: Minimum pairings for a valid response.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: shuffle
attributes.description: Requests shuffling of both match sets. Applied by the transform pipeline (`qti-transformers`), not by this element.

declarations.name: QtiOrderInteraction
declarations.description: Order interaction: candidates arrange choices into a target sequence.

attributes.name: auto-size-dropzones
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Sizes every drop target to the widest chip so placement does not reflow the layout. On by default: an order slot is a socket cut to one chip, and both axes are measured (see DROP-SIZING.md).

attributes.name: disable-animations
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Disables the FLIP move animation.

attributes.name: max-associations
attributes.description: Non-QTI vocabulary inherited from the drag-drop mixin; currently the only way to set the upper bound. QTI spells this `max-choices`.

attributes.name: max-choices
attributes.description: Not implemented. The QTI-correct spelling of the upper bound. See plans/interaction-attribute-spec-conformance.md.

attributes.name: min-associations
attributes.description: Non-QTI vocabulary inherited from the drag-drop mixin; currently the only way to set the lower bound. QTI spells this `min-choices`.

attributes.name: min-choices
attributes.description: Not implemented. The QTI-correct spelling of the lower bound. See plans/interaction-attribute-spec-conformance.md.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: orientation of choices

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: shuffle
attributes.description: Requests choice shuffling. Applied by the transform pipeline (`qti-transformers`), not by this element.

declarations.name: QtiTextEntryInteraction
declarations.description: Text-entry interaction: single-line inline text input.

attributes.name: base
attributes.description: Not implemented. Numeric base used when recording the value.

attributes.name: data-patternmask-message
attributes.description: Custom validation message shown when `pattern-mask` fails. Part of the QTI shared interaction vocabulary.

attributes.name: expected-length
attributes.description: Hint at the expected answer length; drives the rendered field width and the input's `maxlength`.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Not implemented. QTI types this as a bare normalized string here rather than as the `plain | preformatted | xhtml` vocabulary it defines for extended-text, and a single-line input has no formatting to render: it can show neither preserved line breaks nor markup. The field is always plain text, so this is not planned either.

attributes.name: pattern-mask
attributes.description: Regular expression the value must match to be valid.

attributes.name: placeholder-text
attributes.description: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Required. Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: string-identifier
attributes.description: Not implemented. Identifier of a second, string-typed response variable that also receives the raw entry.
